description.value: A backcountry wilderness camp within Tweedsmuir Provincial Park (South), set amid some of BC's most dramatic mountain and river scenery; access involves rough or 4x4 roads, trails are poorly maintained, and self-sufficiency in active grizzly bear habitat is required.

The BC Parks site confirms active camping in the park (prominent 'Book camping' feature; backcountry camping listed under reservations topics) and describes a remote wilderness setting along the Bella Coola Valley. enrichment_extras.notes: Tweedsmuir Park (South) is directly accessible from Highway 20 (Bella Coola Highway), a corridor used by touring cyclists. Backcountry camping within the park may require park-use permits. BC Parks general contact: parkinfo@gov.bc.ca / 1-800-689-9025 (toll-free).
